test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A and B complete a work in 6 days. If A alone can do it in 7 days, then B alone can do it in ______________ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 6 days

A = 7 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM(6,7) units = 42 units

Rate = units per day

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 42 units

⇒ (A + B) rate = 42 ÷ 6 = 7 units/day

⇒ A rate = 42 ÷ 7 = 6 units/day

⇒ B rate = 7 - 6 = 1 unit/day

⇒ B time = 42 ÷ 1 = 42 days

**∴ B alone = 42 days.**
